item.text: The repository already implements Tasks 001–010. Task 011 needs a saved task-order field: sorting by task ID would place an older moved task before the destination’s existing tasks. I’ll preserve the current order during migration, add append-on-move behavior, and add destination controls that retain the source page’s filters.
